newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF says in U.S. alliance with Rockwell.
newsitem.headline: SKF says in U.S. alliance with Rockwell.

text.p: Swedish rollerbearing manufacturer SKF on Friday said it was building a distribution net in the U.S. through an alliance with Rockwell Automation, with network headquarters in Tennessee.

"SKF and Rockwell Automation officials announced today that they have formed an integrated logistics alliance and will share a distribution facility in Crossville, Tennessee," SKF said in a statement.
Through the distribution network the companies plan to offer 24-hour deliveries to most U.S. locations, it said.
Rockwell Automation's Dodge and Reliance Electric products as well as SKF branded products would be included in the network, it said.
Both companies in the alliance make and distribute mechanical power transmission products, electrical motors and drives, and bearing products for worldwide markets.
